chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 170 — Li Huowang Wins by Becoming Danyangzi
chapter_meta_description: The final Zuowandao falls, but Li Huowang’s victory is hollow. As his body crumbles, he realizes he has become the very monster he feared.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 170 — He Made It
og_description: Li Huowang laughs as he realizes: Li Huowang wouldn’t kill innocents. But Danyangzi would. This Daoist has made it.
twitter_description: Li Huowang’s final victory comes at the cost of his own identity. He has become Danyangzi.
